recentDiary.text: Feel fine. Not tired, really. Went to sleep anyway. Will wake up on my own.
Explored again. Found nothing new. More bored this time. Not sure what to do next.
Sat in the chair. Used the computer again. Looked up why the first computer bug was an actual moth. Not done reading. More bored.

Looked up why the first computer bug was a moth in the browser. On September 9, 1947, a moth was found in relay 70 of the Harvard Mark II and taped into the logbook. The word bug already meant a fault before that.
